tools.name: get_mcp_report
tools.description: The detailed view of one MCP server: every check with its state, plus the observed tool list. Get the full observed report for one already-tracked MCP server on MCP Checkup, by provider/name — with its full check breakdown and toolset. An untracked target comes back with status "unknown", not an err
